scenes.say: A new member is joining one of your groups. There's no paper form, and no chasing signatures. You send them a link of their own.
Open the group on the staff page. Under links to send, open the box that says make a link for a new member.
Type their name, their mobile, the date their cover starts, and the plans they're joining. Their HR contact is already filled in, straight from Salesforce.
Press make the link. It's ready to copy in a second, with a WhatsApp message already written around it.
Paste it into respond dot I O, and send it. Only they can open that link, and it stays open for sixty days.
They open the link on their phone. Their name, their company and their cover are already there. It takes about ten minutes.
They add their own details and their family, answer the health questions with a single tick, and sign on the screen with a finger.
The moment they send it, their HR contact sees it's ready to check. HR reads Guardian's own form, fills in the employer's part, and approves it.
It goes straight to Guardian Life, with our branch copied. Our team gets the task, and follows it up every three working days.
And on the staff page, you see where every new member stands. Waiting on them, ready to check, or sent to Guardian Life.
One link. Nothing retyped, and every step on the record. That's our branch. A journey, not a transaction.
